'''2007 Worlds Day 2 James Booker DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Chicago = Worst City Ever. Line 12 Brief Loss Of Control (V) struck on sheet but retained for 60. Line 3 → [[Luke? Luuuuke!]]. Partner LS not yet in inventory map.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[James Booker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decsheets|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
